_comment: Boxes needed for Team Scanner OCR. Run: python3 tools/pixel_inspector.py --measure

boxes.name: moves_more/tab_label
boxes.description: The 'Moves & More' tab label text at the top (for screen detection)

boxes.name: moves_more/card_bg_0
boxes.description: Solid purple background region inside card 0 (Garchomp) â€” for color-gate detection

boxes.name: moves_more/species_0
boxes.description: Species name 'Garchomp' text â€” top-left card (card 0). Crop tightly around the text only.

boxes.name: moves_more/species_1
boxes.description: Species name 'Venusaur' text â€” top-right card (card 1). Same height/width as species_0, shifted right.

boxes.name: moves_more/species_2
boxes.description: Species name 'Charizard' text â€” middle-left card (card 2). Same as species_0, shifted down one row.

boxes.name: moves_more/ability_0
boxes.description: Ability name 'Rough Skin' text in card 0 (Garchomp). Below species name, smaller text.

boxes.name: moves_more/move_0_0
boxes.description: First move 'Earthquake' text in card 0 (Garchomp). After the type icon, just the move name text.

boxes.name: moves_more/move_0_1
boxes.description: Second move 'Rock Slide' text in card 0 (Garchomp).

boxes.name: moves_more/move_0_2
boxes.description: Third move 'Dragon Claw' text in card 0 (Garchomp).

boxes.name: moves_more/move_0_3
boxes.description: Fourth move 'Stomping Tantrum' text in card 0 (Garchomp). Last move â€” used to compute vertical spacing.

boxes.name: team_reg/species_0
boxes.description: First species name 'Garchomp' in the team list (left column, top slot).

boxes.name: team_reg/species_5
boxes.description: Last species name 'Incineroar' in the team list (left column, bottom slot). Used with species_0 to compute vertical spacing.

boxes.name: team_reg/team_tab_bg
boxes.description: The green/yellow 'Team 1' (or 'Team 2') selected tab background â€” for color-gate detection of this screen.

boxes.name: team_reg/scroll_position
boxes.description: Bottom scrollbar / page-position indicator. Select the region that shows 'we're scrolled to the leftmost position' (teams 1-5 visible). Any text/arrow/dots indicator works. We'll use this to refuse running team scan unless scrolled left.

boxes.name: team_reg/tab_slot_0
boxes.description: Position of Team 1's tab pill (leftmost). Select the center of the pill — the color won't matter here, only the position. This is where we'll check for the selected-green color.

boxes.name: team_reg/tab_slot_1
boxes.description: Position of Team 2's tab pill. Select the center of the pill (whether highlighted or not).

boxes.name: team_reg/tab_slot_2
boxes.description: Position of Team 3's tab pill. Select the center of the pill.

boxes.name: team_reg/tab_slot_3
boxes.description: Position of Team 4's tab pill. Select the center of the pill.

boxes.name: team_reg/tab_slot_4
boxes.description: Position of Team 5's tab pill (rightmost when scrolled left). Select the center of the pill.

boxes.name: team_preview/title_text
boxes.description: The 'Select 4 Pokemon to send into battle' text in the center. For screen detection via OCR (look for 'Select').

boxes.name: team_preview/own_species_0
boxes.description: Own slot 0 (TOP row, unhighlighted Glimmora): species text ONLY. TIGHT crop — just the dark text pixels, no pill background, no border, no gender icon.

boxes.name: team_preview/own_species_5
boxes.description: Own slot 5 (BOTTOM row, unhighlighted Kingambit): species text ONLY. TIGHT crop. Used with slot 0 and 2 to compute row spacing.

boxes.name: team_preview/own_item_0
boxes.description: Own slot 0: item 'Focus Sash' text ONLY. TIGHT crop on the smaller text below species.

boxes.name: team_preview/own_item_5
boxes.description: Own slot 5: item 'Bright Powder' text ONLY. TIGHT crop.

boxes.name: team_preview/opp_sprite_0
boxes.description: Opponent team slot 0 (top right): bounding box around JUST the sprite artwork. Exclude the item icon and the red/pink background pill edges if possible.

boxes.name: team_preview/opp_sprite_5
boxes.description: Opponent team slot 5 (bottom right): bounding box around the sprite. Used with slot 0 to compute row spacing for opponent column.

boxes.name: moves_more/sprite_0
boxes.description: Bounding box around JUST the Garchomp sprite in card 0 (top-left). This is the reference crop we'll use to bootstrap the sprite atlas. Tight crop: exclude the card border and the species-name pill.

boxes.name: team_preview/own_species_2
boxes.description: Own slot 2 (3rd row, unhighlighted): species name 'Rotom'. TIGHT crop around just the dark text — exclude the pill background and any border. This is a midpoint anchor to improve row interpolation.

boxes.name: team_preview/own_item_2
boxes.description: Own slot 2: item name 'Choice Scarf' below the species. TIGHT crop on the dark text only.

boxes.description: Select the opponent species name badge (top-right, pink/red background with white text)
